resumeText:
Rohan Deshpande | Pune | rohan.deshpande@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Game Designer, Sahyadri Play Studios, Pune (2022 - present)
- Designed the core loop and wrote game design documents for a casual puzzle game with 2 million installs.
- Balanced the soft currency economy and level rewards in balancing spreadsheets built in Google Sheets.
- Designed 120 puzzle levels with level progression design based on completion data.
- Prototyped new boosters in Unity before handing them to the engineering team.
- Ran weekly playtest sessions with players and turned feedback into tuning changes.

Junior Game Designer, Pixel Chai Games, Pune (2021 - 2022)
- Wrote feature specs for a card game and tuned card stats with the lead designer.
- Read A/B test results with the analytics team to pick reward values.

EDUCATION
B.Des Game Design, MIT Institute of Design, Pune, 2021

SKILLS
Unity, Excel, Figma, game design, live ops
